items.briefing:
AI tools are increasingly being used on both sides of cybersecurity — to find vulnerabilities and to defend against them. While these developments are mostly overseas, Australian organisations should be aware that AI-powered scams and phishing attempts are becoming more convincing and harder to spot. A recent report highlights a growing wave of AI-generated scam content online, meaning staff need to be more cautious than ever about unsolicited emails, messages, or websites.

OpenAI has also launched a new Chat History feature for ChatGPT on macOS — a reminder to review what data your apps are storing locally on work devices.

**Tip:** Check your ChatGPT app settings and disable chat history if you're discussing sensitive work matters.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical vulnerability backlog leaves Australian organisations dangerously exposed to active exploitation.
